summary: Record LLM latency cost and replayable receipts

delivery.outcome: LLM client calls emit redacted, digest-bound receipts and a deterministic aggregate export with nullable usage and cost.
nonGoals: No live provider calls or provider billing reconciliation.
No prompt, response, credential, or raw provider error storage.
No instrumentation of LLM integrations outside planfile.llm.client.

architecture.decision: Keep a lock-protected JSONL evidence store at an explicit environment path or initialized project .planfile directory. Record hashes and bounded metadata at the client boundary; aggregate without replaying content.
interfaceChanges: call_llm accepts optional metrics_store and correlation_id keyword arguments.
architecture.rollback: Revert the client instrumentation and metrics module; existing provider call behavior remains available.

validation.evidence: Offline provider fakes cover direct and fallback attempts, failure redaction, missing usage, and aggregate export.
